settings.hero_text: Manage AI models, prompts, integrations and account. Model config auto-saves; prompts require manual save.
settings.version.title: Version
settings.version.desc: Check whether a newer version is available.
settings.desktop_close.title: Close Behavior
settings.desktop_close.desc: Desktop only. Decide whether closing the window should ask every time, minimize to the tray, or exit directly.
settings.desktop_close.status_hint: Changes take effect immediately and also control the "Remember this choice" option in the close prompt.
settings.desktop_close.effect_ask: The app will ask every time before closing the window.
settings.desktop_close.effect_minimize: Closing the window will minimize CiteBox to the tray without asking again.
settings.desktop_close.effect_exit: Closing the window will exit CiteBox directly without asking again.
settings.ai.model_desc: Add or edit AI models. Changes are auto-saved.
settings.ai.scene_desc: Assign models for AI Assistant Master/Sub-Agent, reading, and organization scenes, and adjust general settings. Changes are auto-saved.
settings.ai.binding_split_ready_desc: Master and Sub-Agent use different models, which fits planning plus concurrent classification.
settings.ai.binding_split_shared_desc: Both roles currently share one model. Configure multiple models, then apply the recommended binding.
settings.ai.binding_master_desc: Understands the request, plans tool calls, synthesizes evidence, and writes the final answer. A strong reasoning model is recommended.
settings.ai.binding_subagent_desc: Handles titles, candidate judgments, and lightweight classification under high concurrency. A low-cost fast model is recommended.
settings.ai.external_search.title: AI External Search Sources
settings.ai.external_search.desc: Choose which academic search sources the AI assistant uses for external search. Semantic Scholar is controlled by the API key under Literature Search API and is enabled automatically once a key is configured.
settings.ai.external_search.pubmed:
PubMed
Default source; anonymous access is allowed, and API credentials are configured under Literature Search API.
settings.ai.image_gen_desc: Control whether @image-gen is available and its separate API settings. A Codex subscription does not replace the Images API credentials configured here.
settings.ai.image_gen_base_url_placehold: Uses the official endpoint by default; enter a custom URL for compatible gateways
settings.ai.translate_desc: Set the language, model and prompt for text selection translation. Model and language auto-save; prompt requires manual save.
settings.ai.prompt_desc: Edit prompts for each scene and reusable role prompts. Click Save after making changes.
settings.ai.global_prompt_desc: System prompt, Q&A prompt and reusable role prompts. Click Save after making changes.
settings.ai.figure_group_prompt_desc: Prompts for figure interpretation, tag suggestion and group suggestion. Click Save after making changes.
settings.ai.figure_group_prompt_save_hin: Click Save after editing figure & group prompts.
settings.ai.figure_group_prompt_modified: Figure & group prompts modified. Click "Save" to apply.
settings.ai.role_prompt_desc: Reusable role presets. After saving, use @RoleName in the AI Assistant chat to invoke them.
settings.ai.role_prompt_empty: No role prompts saved yet. Create one and use @RoleName in the AI Assistant chat to invoke it.
settings.ai.prompt_modified: Prompts modified. Click "Save Prompt Config" to apply.
settings.ai.restore_done: Default prompts restored. Click "Save Prompt Config" to apply.
settings.ai.restore_done_toast: Default prompts restored. Remember to save.
settings.ai.system_prompt_help: A global role prompt applied to all AI conversations. No need to repeat specific tasks or output formats here.
settings.ai.system_prompt_placeholder: Global role setting, e.g. prioritize citing evidence; state uncertainty when evidence is insufficient
settings.ai.system_prompt_note: This is sent as systemPrompt separately and will not be included in the userPrompt template below.
settings.ai.qa_prompt_help: For single-paper Q&A in the AI Assistant. Full text, abstract, notes, figure summaries and chat history are attached automatically.
settings.ai.qa_prompt_placeholder: Supplementary requirements for paper Q&A, e.g. prioritize conclusions, evidence chains and limitations
settings.ai.figure_prompt_help: For the currently viewed figure only. Write your interpretation focus and criteria here; figure info, full text and output format are attached automatically.
settings.ai.figure_prompt_placeholder: Main task for current figure, e.g. prioritize design, controls, conclusions and limitations
settings.ai.tag_prompt_help: For the currently viewed figure only, generating figure tags. Write tag selection criteria and preferences here; figure info, existing tag library and JSON output format are attached automatically.
settings.ai.tag_prompt_placeholder: Main task for current figure tags, e.g. prefer searchable content tags, avoid overly generic terms
settings.ai.group_prompt_help: For whole-paper group assignment. Current group, group library, abstract, notes and full text are attached automatically.
settings.ai.group_prompt_placeholder: Supplementary requirements for group assignment, e.g. prefer reusing existing groups before suggesting new ones
settings.ai.translate_prompt_help: For desktop text selection translation. The system auto-detects translation direction and provides source text and target language.
settings.ai.translate_prompt_placeholder: e.g. return only the translated text, merge soft PDF line wraps inside paragraphs, preserve natural paragraphs, terms, abbreviations and units
settings.ai.translate_prompt_save_hint: Click Save after editing translation prompt.
settings.ai.translate_prompt_modified: Translation prompt modified. Click "Save Translation Prompt" to apply.
settings.ai.tts_prompt_help: Used to rewrite existing answers into a version that TTS can read naturally. The system already provides the source text; use this field to specify cleanup rules, speaking style, and what must be preserved.
settings.ai.tts_prompt_placeholder: e.g. remove Markdown and figure:// references, keep terminology, numbers, and gene names, and rewrite into natural spoken prose
settings.ai.base_url_placeholder: Uses official endpoint by default; enter custom URL for compatible gateways
settings.ai.legacy_mode: Use legacy OpenAI mode (Chat Completions) for compatibility with other OpenAI-style gateways
settings.ai.model_editor_saving: Current model changes will be auto-saved.
settings.ai.model_keep_one: At least one AI model must be kept
settings.ai.no_models: No models yet. Add one to get started.
settings.ai.provider_note_openai: OpenAI uses Responses API by default. Enable legacy mode to switch to Chat Completions; compatible gateways such as DeepSeek can also use thinking and reasoning_effort.
settings.ai.provider_note_anthropic: Anthropic uses the native Messages API. Enter a compatible Base URL and model name.
settings.ai.provider_note_gemini: Gemini uses the generateContent endpoint. API Key is sent via query parameter.
settings.ai.provider_note_codex: Desktop only. Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login and subscription allowance, never reads or stores login credentials, and never falls back to API billing automatically.
settings.ai.role_overwrite_confirm: A role named "{0}" already exists. Overwrite?
settings.ai.role_editor_desc: A role prompt stores role info only. After saving, type @RoleName in the AI Assistant chat to invoke it.
settings.ai.role_editor_prompt_placehold: e.g. You are a strict paper reviewer focusing on evidence chains, method gaps and conclusion boundaries.
settings.extractor.title: PDF Extraction
settings.extractor.desc: Choose extraction profile. Switch between manual, built-in LLM coordinate extraction, or standard pdffigx.
settings.extractor.pdffigx_hint: For standard pdffigx, just enter the service root URL like `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. The system will auto-append `/api/v1/extract` and `/api/v1/jobs`.
settings.extractor.manual_hint: Manual mode: no automatic figure extraction. Full text is saved on upload from both web and WeChat. You can add figures manually later.
settings.extractor.builtin_hint: Built-in LLM extraction does not require pdffigx URL, auth or poll settings. Figure coordinates are detected by the selected multimodal model; full text defaults to browser pdf.js with server fallback.
settings.weixin.title: WeChat
settings.weixin.desc: Configure WeChat message bridge, binding status, and the model used for IM intent recognition.
settings.weixin.overview_heading: Receive messages, upload references and trigger extraction via WeChat
settings.weixin.overview_text: When bridging is on, you can upload PDFs, ask questions or run commands directly from WeChat. IM intent model changes are auto-saved.
settings.weixin.bridge_desc: Control whether to receive and reply to WeChat messages. Changes take effect after saving.
settings.weixin.bridge_checkbox:
Enable WeChat notifications
When on, messages are received and replied via WeChat; when off, no messages are sent or received.
settings.weixin.bridge_modified: Modified. Click "Save WeChat Bridge Config" to apply.
settings.weixin.daily_desc: When enabled, CiteBox sends one random saved figure to the bound WeChat account at the configured time each day, and also supports an immediate test send.
settings.weixin.daily_checkbox:
Enable daily recommendation
Send one random figure to the currently bound WeChat account at a fixed time every day.
settings.weixin.daily_help: The test send uses the current form values directly. Scheduled sending uses the saved config. Automatic sends do not run while the bridge is off or no account is bound.
settings.weixin.daily_save_hint: Click Save to apply daily recommendation changes.
settings.weixin.daily_modified: Modified. Click "Save Daily Recommendation Config" to apply.
settings.weixin.daily_enabled_current: Daily recommendation is on and will send one random figure every day at {0}.
settings.weixin.daily_enabled_bridge_off: Daily recommendation is on and scheduled for {0}, but the WeChat bridge is off so it will not send automatically.
settings.weixin.daily_enabled_not_bound: Daily recommendation is on and scheduled for {0}, but no WeChat account is currently bound so it will not send automatically.
settings.weixin.daily_test_hint: Click "Send Test Figure" to immediately send one random figure to the bound WeChat account.
settings.weixin.daily_testing_status: Sending one random test figure to the bound WeChat account...
settings.weixin.daily_test_ok: The test figure was sent to WeChat.
settings.weixin.daily_test_requires_bind: Bind WeChat first before testing image sends.
settings.tts.title: TTS Config
settings.tts.desc: Manage Doubao TTS independently. You can test it directly on this page; it is currently used by WeChat `/ask`, `/qa`, and `/testvoice`.
settings.tts.app_id_placeholder: Enter the Volcengine speech App ID
settings.tts.access_key_placeholder: Enter the Volcengine speech access token
settings.tts.speaker: Doubao TTS Speaker
settings.tts.speaker_placeholder: Enter a speaker ID available in your console
settings.tts.help: Leave blank to disable TTS. After saving, successful WeChat `/ask` or `/qa` replies include an extra Doubao TTS audio attachment, and `/testvoice` uses the current saved config to generate a Hello World sample.
settings.tts.save_hint: Click Save to apply TTS changes.
settings.tts.test_hint: The test uses the current form values directly. When it succeeds, you can play the audio below.
settings.tts.modified: TTS config modified. Click "Save TTS Config" to apply.
settings.tts.testing_status: Synthesizing a sample with the current TTS config...
settings.tts.test_ok: TTS test succeeded. You can play the sample now.
settings.weixin.tts_desc: Manage Doubao TTS separately. It is currently used only for WeChat `/ask` and `/qa` voice replies.
settings.weixin.tts_app_id_placeholder: Enter the Volcengine speech App ID
settings.weixin.tts_access_key_placehold: Enter the Volcengine speech Access Key
settings.weixin.tts_speaker_placeholder: Enter a speaker ID available in your console
settings.weixin.tts_help: Leave blank to disable WeChat Ask TTS. When configured, only successful `/ask` or `/qa` replies include an extra Doubao TTS audio attachment. `/testvoice` uses the currently saved config to generate a Hello World sample.
settings.weixin.tts_save_hint: Click Save to apply TTS changes.
settings.weixin.tts_test_hint: The test uses the current form values directly. When it succeeds, you can play the audio below.
settings.weixin.tts_modified: TTS config modified. Click "Save TTS Config" to apply.
settings.weixin.testing_tts_status: Synthesizing a sample with the current TTS config...
settings.weixin.tts_test_ok: TTS test succeeded. You can play the sample now.
settings.weixin.binding_desc: Scan QR code to bind. Once bound, upload references and send messages directly from WeChat.
settings.weixin.binding_status_hint: Click "Start Binding" to generate a QR code.
settings.weixin.qr_placeholder_text: Click "Start Binding" to show a QR code. You can also use it to rebind when already bound.
settings.weixin.qr_scan_hint: Scan with WeChat. Re-generate if expired.
settings.weixin.qr_session_empty: QR session is empty, cannot track binding status
settings.weixin.unbind_confirm: Unbind WeChat? You will stop receiving WeChat messages.
settings.weixin.binding_scanned: QR scanned, please confirm in WeChat
settings.weixin.detail_not_bound: No WeChat account bound. Save bridge settings first, then scan QR code to bind.
settings.weixin.detail_ready: Bridge and binding are ready. Upload PDFs, send messages and trigger extraction via WeChat.
settings.weixin.detail_no_binding: Bridge is on but no account is bound. Generate a QR code and scan to start.
settings.weixin.detail_bridge_off: Account is bound but bridge is off. No messages will be sent or received.
settings.wolai.title: Wolai
settings.wolai.desc: Configure Wolai authorization and target page to sync notes.
settings.wolai.token_placeholder: Paste a token that can call OpenAPI directly
settings.wolai.parent_block_placeholder: Notes will be saved as sub-pages under this page
settings.wolai.usage_hint: "Test Token" verifies access. "Insert Test Page" creates a Test Page with content and an image export TODO note. "Save to Wolai" saves the current draft as a new block page without replacing local saves, but images are currently written as TODO placeholders.
settings.wolai.testing_status: Verifying Wolai token and target block access...
settings.wolai.inserting_status: Creating Wolai test page with image export TODO...
settings.mcp.title: Notion
settings.mcp.desc: Configure Notion MCP for the AI assistant and Notion API for native image-note exports.
settings.mcp.mcp_desc: Connect the remote MCP with OAuth for @Notion in the AI assistant.
settings.mcp.name: Name
settings.mcp.usage_hint: After authorization, enable the connection and type @Notion in the AI assistant to select it. Test does not persist the connection or credentials; Save persists them after authorization succeeds.
settings.mcp.status_hint: Click Test or Save to start OAuth in the browser.
settings.mcp.opening_browser: Preparing OAuth and opening the authorization page...
settings.notion_api.title: Notion API
settings.notion_api.desc: Use a personal access token and the Notion File Upload API to save original images and figure notes.
settings.notion_api.token_hint: The token is stored only on this device and is never displayed. Figure-note export requires Notion API access.
settings.notion_api.status_hint: Enter a token to test or save it. Native image export is available after saving.
settings.integration.title: Research Context Integration
settings.integration.desc: Run an embedded local MCP server so external tools like Wisp can read your library.
settings.integration.service_desc: When enabled, CiteBox serves an MCP endpoint on a local port (127.0.0.1 only).
settings.integration.token_desc: External tools authenticate with a Bearer token. The plaintext token is shown only once when generated and cannot be recovered later.
settings.integration.token_once_warning: This token is shown only once. Copy and store it now.
settings.integration.token_status_hint: External tools can access this service after a token is generated.
settings.integration.rotate_success: New token generated — copy it now.
settings.integration.rotate_confirm: Rotating invalidates the current token immediately; tools using it must be updated. Continue?
settings.integration.revoke_confirm: Revoking blocks all external tools using this token. Continue?
settings.integration.copy_failed: Copy failed. Please copy it manually.
settings.integration.wisp_desc: Copy the connection config with the server URL and token, then paste it into Wisp to connect.
settings.integration.copy_config_hint: Generate a new token before copying the config; existing tokens cannot be revealed again.
settings.integration.config_need_token: Generate a new token first, then copy the config.
settings.integration.extension_desc: Install the CiteBox Connector browser extension to save papers to your library with one click from any paper page.
settings.integration.extension_step1: The extension ships with the app: find the extension/ folder in the CiteBox installation directory.
settings.integration.extension_step2: Open chrome://extensions in Chrome / Edge and enable "Developer mode".
settings.integration.extension_step3: Click "Load unpacked" and select that extension/ folder.
settings.integration.extension_step4: Open the extension's options page, enter this server's URL and the access token generated above, then test the connection.
settings.research.title: Literature Search API
settings.research.desc: Configure Semantic Scholar and PubMed / NCBI credentials. Semantic Scholar powers the /research literature search page; PubMed powers AI assistant external search.
settings.research.s2.label: Semantic Scholar API key
settings.research.s2.hint: Leave blank to use anonymous rate (~1 req/s). Changes take effect immediately on save.
settings.research.pubmed.hint: PubMed can be left blank for anonymous access; add an NCBI API key for higher request limits.
settings.password.account_desc: Change password, manage remembered sign-in, or sign out.
settings.password.change_desc: Change the admin account login password
settings.password.remember_desc: When enabled, this device restores your sign-in automatically next time without asking for the password again.
settings.password.remember_checkbox:
Remember sign-in on this device
After closing and reopening the browser, CiteBox will sign in automatically. Turning this off takes effect immediately.
settings.password.remember_status_enable: This device is currently remembered and future visits will sign in automatically.
settings.password.remember_status_disabl: This device is not currently remembered.
settings.password.remember_toast_enabled: This device will now stay signed in
settings.password.remember_toast_disable: Remembered sign-in has been turned off for this device
settings.password.empty_fields: Please fill in all password fields
settings.password.too_short: New password must be at least 6 characters
settings.password.changed_toast: Password changed. Please sign in with the new password.
settings.db.title: Database
settings.db.desc: Export, import or purge the database. Import will overwrite existing data.
settings.db.export_desc: Download a full backup of the current database
settings.db.import_desc: Restore from a backup file, overwriting existing data
settings.db.import_no_file: Please select a database file to import
settings.db.import_confirm_message: Importing will overwrite all references, figures, groups and tags with the backup file. This starts immediately after confirmation.
settings.db.purge_desc: Delete all references, figures, groups and tags. This cannot be undone.
settings.db.purge_confirm_message: This will delete all references, extracted figures, groups and tags permanently. Only use this when you want to reset the entire library.
settings.zotero.title: Zotero
settings.zotero.desc: Connect to the local Zotero API and import collections through CiteBox's standard ingest pipeline.
settings.zotero.connection_desc: Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:23119/api. Enable Local API in Zotero Settings → Advanced and keep Zotero running.
settings.zotero.status_hint: Save the URL, then test the connection.
settings.zotero.import_desc: Items with local PDFs use the standard ingest and extraction pipeline. Items without PDFs stay in the missing-PDF list.
settings.zotero.import_hint: Test the connection, then choose collections.
settings.zotero.no_collections: No collections yet. Test the connection first.
settings.zotero.no_missing: No items waiting for a PDF.
settings.zotero.attach_done: PDF attached through the standard ingest path
settings.figure_library.title: Scientific Figure Library
settings.figure_library.desc: Write the current figure Transfer Package to a local drop folder. ScientificFigureLibrary can import it with packagePath as a draft. CiteBox does not write the SFL library or auto-publish.
settings.figure_library.drop_desc: Use an absolute local path such as your gallery inbox/citebox. The figure viewer Send button writes the zip there.
settings.figure_library.status_hint: Save the folder, then test that it is writable.
settings.figure_library.load_failed: Failed to load Figure Library settings
